newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PANEL MULLS VILFIMA ASSET MANAGEMENT PERMIT.
newsitem.headline: PANEL MULLS VILFIMA ASSET MANAGEMENT PERMIT.

text.p: The securities commission is to decide on Friday whether to grant a license for Vilfima to start an asset management company, Vilfima said on Friday.
Vilfima is one of the top three brokerages in Lithuania.
"I think now everything is clear and there is no reason for the securities commission not to grant a license," Vidas Jelinskas, head of the brokerage, told Reuters.
"If they reject us today, we will apply again," Jelinskas added.
Jelinskas said Vilfima's T-bill, equity and individual portfolios would be moved to Vilfima asset management and potential investment funds would also be managed there.
"If we manage to create a fund or a fund family, it will need to be managed and the asset management company will do this," Jelinskas said.
Vilfima broker Grazhina Bachiuliene is set to assume the position of general manager of Vilfima asset management, Jelinskas said.
